note: Known sermon series. The YouTube sync uses this to sort messages into series and to strip boilerplate out of titles, because the video titles spell things inconsistently. Add a new series when one starts.

howto.name: The series name as it should read on the website.
howto.subtitle: The long strap-line the church repeats in every video title for this series. It is stripped out so the sermon's own title is what shows.
howto.aliases: Any misspelling or variant that has gone out on YouTube.

notSermonsNote: Titles matching any of these are not treated as sermons and never reach the website. A plain entry is matched as a substring; an entry beginning 're:' is a regular expression. Regexes are written without backslashes on purpose, because this file gets edited by hand and escaping is easy to get silently wrong. The anchors matter: a video titled just 'worship' is a full-service recording with no sermon in the title, while 'SHADOW WORSHIP' is a sermon. The sync prints everything it skipped so this list can be corrected.
